newsitem.title: UK: Trocadero's Enid Blyton Co in JV with BBC.
newsitem.headline: Trocadero's Enid Blyton Co in JV with BBC.

text.p: British leisure group Trocadero PLC said its subsidiary, the Enid Blyton Co, has entered a joint venture with BBC Worldwide to create a new television series.

The 40-part animated series will feature Noddy and other characters from the Toyland world created by author Enid Blyton. It will be aired in the United States on PBS, the U.S. public broadcaster, and in Canada from 1998 for a minimum of two years.
The maximum production budget will be $7.5 million and will be shared equally between BBC Worldwide and the Enid Blyton Co, Trocadero said in a statement.
Trocadero, which demerged from Burford Holdings Plc in 1995, owns the copyrights to all the printed works of Enid Blyton through its subsidiary.
